node.statement: Validated node 1.1.1.3 gives c0>=1, hence c0>=0. For each X in {U,V}, the root hypothesis epsilon_X<=W.L*epsilon may therefore be multiplied by c0 without reversing order, giving c0*epsilon_X<=c0*W.L*epsilon. Validated node 1.2.3.2 gives W.L*epsilon<=t_3 and c0*W.L*epsilon<=t_3. Combining these with the unchanged root hypotheses d_X<=c0*epsilon_X and ||v_X(I_{B_X})-u_{A_X}||<=c0*epsilon_X yields d_X<=c0*epsilon_X<=c0*W.L*epsilon<=t_3 and, separately for X=U and X=V, ||v_X(I_{B_X})-u_{A_X}||<=c0*epsilon_X<=c0*W.L*epsilon<=t_3. Since W.c0_cb=c0, the sharper hypotheses d_X<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_X remain exactly the supplied ones.
